_comment: Rhai token grammar for colouring, not parsing (UI spec §1.1). Each surface generates its tokenizer from this file; a tolerant colorizer must never throw on partial input. Lexical rules are described, not compiled: the regexes are ECMAScript-flavoured and every surface re-expresses them in its own engine.

comment.note: An unterminated block comment colours to end of buffer.

string.note: An unterminated string colours to end of line (to end of buffer for the multiline forms) and must not suppress colouring of later lines.

map_token_note: Values are the foundation syntax.* tokens (key/string/number/boolean/punct) plus the additive comment/keyword/text tokens (UI spec §1.1). `true`/`false`/`()` colour as boolean.
